skonester_legend_master_finalize_new_legend_effect = {
  scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target = {
    random_legend = {
      limit = {
        legend_owner = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target
        NOT = { legend_quality = mythical }
      }
      change_legend_quality_effect = { VALUE = 100 }
      change_legend_quality_effect = { VALUE = 100 }
      set_variable = { name = legend_quality_progress value = 100 }
    }
    random_legend = {
      limit = { legend_owner = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target }
      save_scope_as = skonester_new_legend
    }
    if = {
      limit = { exists = scope:skonester_new_legend }
      set_promoted_legend = scope:skonester_new_legend
    }
  }
}

skonester_legend_master_ensure_target_scope_effect = {
  skonester_cheat_menu_sync_target_effect = yes
  if = {
    limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target } }
    scope:actor = { save_scope_as = skonester_cheat_menu_target }
  }
}

skonester_legend_master_clear_owned_legends_effect = {
  skonester_legend_master_ensure_target_scope_effect = yes
  if = {
    limit = { exists = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target }
    scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target = {
      save_scope_as = skonester_legend_clear_victim
      stop_promoting_legend = yes
      remove_character_modifier = skonester_legend_spread_speed_fast_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = skonester_legend_spread_speed_very_fast_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = skonester_legend_spread_speed_instant_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = skonester_legend_master_spread_cheat_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = legend_spread_debug_modifier
    }
    while = {
      limit = {
        any_legend = { legend_owner = scope:skonester_legend_clear_victim }
      }
      random_legend = {
        limit = { legend_owner = scope:skonester_legend_clear_victim }
        destroy_legend = yes
      }
    }
    scope:actor = {
      send_interface_toast = {
        type = event_toast_effect_good
        title = skonester_legend_master_clear_toast_title
        desc = skonester_legend_master_clear_toast_desc
        left_icon = scope:skonester_cheat_menu_target
      }
    }
  }
}
